description: Na₄Ge₂Te₅ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are eight inequivalent Na sites. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 6-14°. There are a spread of Na-Te bond distances ranging from 3.27-3.40 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to five Te atoms to form NaTe₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with seven NaTe₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaTe₅ square pyramid, corners with three GeGeTe₃ tetrahedra, edges with three NaTe₆ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one NaTe₅ square pyramid,  an edgeedge with one GeGeTe₃ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaTe₅ trigonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 5-84°. There are a spread of Na-Te bond distances ranging from 3.20-3.37 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to six Te atoms to form NaTe₆ octahedra that share corners with four NaTe₆ octahedra, corners with five GeGeTe₃ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaTe₅ trigonal bipyramid, edges with nine NaTe₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one GeGeTe₃ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 2-7°. There are a spread of Na-Te bond distances ranging from 3.22-3.59 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded to six Te atoms to form NaTe₆ octahedra that share corners with two NaTe₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaTe₅ square pyramid, corners with five GeGeTe₃ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaTe₅ trigonal bipyramid, edges with six NaTe₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent NaTe₅ square pyramids,  an edgeedge with one GeGeTe₃ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaTe₅ trigonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 2-14°. There are a spread of Na-Te bond distances ranging from 3.19-3.56 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded to six Te atoms to form NaTe₆ octahedra that share corners with two NaTe₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaTe₅ square pyramid, corners with five GeGeTe₃ tetrahedra, corners with three equivalent NaTe₅ trigonal bipyramids, edges with five NaTe₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent NaTe₅ square pyramids,  an edgeedge with one GeGeTe₃ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaTe₅ trigonal bipyramid.
